تحثون (form I)
# تَحُثُّونَ (taḥuṯṯūna) /ta.ħuθ.θuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of حَثَّ (ḥaṯṯa)
# تُحَثُّونَ (tuḥaṯṯūna) /tu.ħaθ.θuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of حَثَّ (ḥaṯṯa)
